stories.headline: Nabers Walks Out of the Infirmary and the Whole Giants Camp Stands Up
stories.read: Ten months after that knee gave out in Week 4, Malik Nabers is back on the practice field runnin' routes with the outfit. No promises on Week 1 and there may be a leash on him early, but the fella is upright and movin'. Here's your read, pardner: the saloon has been sellin' him cheap all summer on account of the busted wing, and a healthy Nabers is the biggest cut of the throws in that whole territory. That's a vein trading at half price. Go stake it before the rest of the herd catches wind, and note that Wan'Dale and the leftovers just went dry.

stories.headline: Green Bay Springs Tucker Kraft Off the Sick List and Nobody Noticed
stories.read: The Packers pulled Kraft off the can't-play list and got him back on the grass, nine months out from a torn knee. LaFleur is takin' it slow, individual work only for now, with a joint scrimmage against Arizona on the 26th circled as the real target. Doc has been sayin' it for weeks: the market on tight ends dries up fast after the top two, and here sits a fella who was a genuine strike before he took the spill. The nervous folks in your outfit will let him slide a full round past his worth because they saw the word 'knee' and got spooked. Let 'em be spooked. You take the discount.

stories.headline: The 49ers Backfield Is a Field Hospital, So They Hired the First Healthy Horse They Found
stories.read: Five days into camp San Francisco signed Khalil Herbert to a one-year deal, and the reason is plain as a dusty road: he is the only backup ball-carrier in the barn who can still walk. That's a bad sign for the wounded and a mighty interesting one for anybody payin' attention. Christian McCaffrey is a gold mine when he's healthy and a rumor when he ain't, and the spare horse behind him in that Shanahan wagon has always been worth real money. Herbert costs you nothin' but the last pick of your bench. That's a lottery ticket priced like a cup of coffee, and Doc buys that ticket every time.
